title: PreflightResult
description: Cross-process payload emitted by a module's preflight subprocess (stdout JSON) and parsed by the bridge. See specs/051-post-revival-hardening/contracts/preflight.contract.md.

verdict.description: success → run module normally; warning → run + record corrections; fatal_fail → skip THIS module only (Principle VIII isolation). Subprocess crash/timeout/garbage-stdout maps to fatal_fail (fail-closed).

corrections.description: Suggested fixes for malformed sources.yaml entries. May be empty.

original.description: Malformed value exactly as written in sources.yaml.

applied.description: true = correction used for this cycle's extraction; false = suggestion only.

messages.description: Human-readable notes surfaced in the cycle report. May be empty.
